name: dsh-xcode
description: Connect Codex to Apple's official Xcode MCP bridge (xcrun mcpbridge) for sub-second single-file Swift diagnostics, native SwiftUI #Preview rendering, warm incremental builds and tests, and Apple Developer Documentation search.

interface.shortDescription: Live Xcode diagnostics, SwiftUI #Preview rendering, and scheme builds via xcrun mcpbridge
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex directly to Apple's official Xcode Model Context Protocol bridge (xcrun mcpbridge) with automatic tabIdentifier routing and Xcode 26 structuredContent normalization. Check single-file Swift compiler issues in sub-seconds without a full build, render SwiftUI #Preview macros to PNG snapshots, run warm incremental builds and XCTest/Swift Testing suites, and search local Apple documentation.
defaultPrompt: Check Xcode bridge status and list open project windows.
Run single-file Xcode diagnostics on the active Swift file and fix any compiler errors.
Render the SwiftUI #Preview for the current view and inspect its layout.
